FlipLens / Partner programme

Earn 20% for 6 months

Make videos about flea market finds, flips or selling on Vinted? Show your audience FlipLens and earn from every person who subscribes through your link.

Who it is for

Resellers and creators on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube who post about flea markets, thrift finds, flipping electronics or selling on Vinted, eBay and Kleinanzeigen. Normal users can join too: everyone with a FlipLens account gets an invite link.

What you earn

  • 20% of every payment made by people who sign up with your link, without taxes.
  • For 6 months from each person's first payment, renewals included.
  • Earnings become available 14 days after each payment (the refund period).
  • Payouts from €20 by PayPal or bank transfer, requested in the app.

Example: 50 people on Pro (€9.99 a month) bring you about €99.90 a month for 6 months.

What your audience gets

People who create a new account with your link get 10 extra free checks in their first month, on top of the free plan. They can check what an item resells for, see their profit after fees and write Vinted, eBay or Kleinanzeigen listings from a photo.

How to join

  1. Sign in at fliplens.eu with Google.
  2. Open Profile, then "Invite friends".
  3. Copy your link (fliplens.eu/?ref=yourcode) and share it in your bio, videos and stories.

Want a custom code such as ?ref=anna? Write to support@fliplens.eu after signing in.

Content ideas

  • Flea market check: "Is it worth buying?" with the verdict on screen.
  • Before and after flips with the real profit.
  • "I turned this into a Vinted listing in 10 seconds."
  • Share-your-find cards from the app in your stories.

Rules

  • Label sponsored content as advertising (in Germany "Werbung" or "Anzeige").
  • No misleading claims about earnings or results, no spam.
  • No search ads on the FlipLens name, no self-referrals or extra accounts.

Full rules: Terms, section "Referral programme".

Questions

Does it cost anything to join?

No. Every signed-in user has an invite link, and the free plan is enough to take part.

How long do I earn from a person I invite?

6 months from their first payment. You receive 20% of every payment in that time, renewals included.

When and how do I get paid?

Earnings become available 14 days after each payment. From €20 you can request a payout by PayPal or bank transfer in the app; it is usually paid within 14 days.

Who pays taxes on my earnings?

You do. Earnings are paid without tax deductions; declare them as required in your country.
